source.title: Korean Revised Version 1961 (KRV)
source.rights: Economic rights expired on 2011-12-31 according to the Korean Bible Society. Attribution and integrity rights remain; text is attributed to the Korean Bible Society and is not paraphrased.

auxiliary.title: KRV 1961 HolyBible transcription and native merged-verse markers
auxiliary.purpose: Supplies only the edition's native omitted- and merged-verse markers; the primary source supplies Scripture wording.

markup.jesusWords: Native source wj spans take precedence. Full-verse inheritance follows the pinned KJV1769 wj source. All KJV-mixed native units have edition-specific reviewed, raw-text-hash-pinned speech spans or explicit reviewed omissions; narration is not colored.
markup.translatorAdditions: USFM add spans are preserved as [ADD] markers.
markup.footnotesAndCrossReferences: Source apparatus is excluded from display text.

headings.textSource: Localized editorial headings already shipped with the app; not publisher headings for this alternate edition.
headings.placement: Explicit per-chapter beforeVerse lookup in the alternate edition's displayed coordinates.
headings.emptyChapters: Stored as explicit empty arrays; runtime fallback is forbidden.

sources.method: Reviewed clause-boundary bridge; source 20:32 contains Jesus' call and question, while KRV 20:32 contains the call and KRV 20:33 contains the question and answer. Native verses remain whole.
sources.sourceAuthority: Rendered RNKSV Bible.com parity checkpoint and checked-in source chapter
sources.targetAuthority: SHA-pinned KRV 1961 source and validated traditional overlay

sources.method: Same-coordinate identity only for complete native units untouched by existing exception rules; combined lines remain whole. Non-English base stories require fresh hash-bound rendered Bible.com parity. Text similarity is diagnostic, not a gate.
sources.targetAuthority: SHA-pinned traditional source archive and validated overlay
